analysis.title: Vertiv Holdings (VRT): Strong quarter with 2026 guidance raised, and momentum into 2027; 3Q26 wrap
key_insights: GS calls 3Q26 results and 4Q26/2026 guidance well above both GS and the Street on revenue, adjusted EBIT and adjusted EPS. Vertiv reported 3Q26 revenue/adjusted EBIT/adjusted EPS of $4,313 mn/$1,087 mn/$2.21 vs Street at $3,749 mn/$922 mn/$1.82.

3Q26 revenue was up 32% qoq as reported and up 55% yoy organically, vs GS at $3,765 mn, Street at $3,749 mn and a guidance range of $3,650 mn-$3,850 mn. Organic growth was 55% vs 18% in the prior quarter.
Organic growth was broad-based by region in 3Q26: Americas about +66% yoy, APAC about +48%, EMEA +19%. Prior quarter was Americas +21%, APAC +26%, EMEA -2%.
3Q26 orders grew over 100% organically yoy, with the pipeline expanding and momentum heading into 2027. Management is adding capacity to address the supply chain issues seen last quarter.
About $100 mn-$150 mn of delayed 2Q revenue was recovered in 3Q. Management reported improved execution in 3Q and additional capacity coming online.

Adjusted operating profit was $1,087 mn (25.2% of sales) vs Street $922 mn (24.6%), GS $924 mn (24.6%) and a guidance range of $898 mn-$938 mn. Adjusted EPS including SBC was $2.21 vs Street $1.82, GS $1.81 and guidance of $1.77-$1.83.

Vertiv closed the acquisitions of King Environmental Services and Utility Innovation Group (UIG). UIG cost ~$1.45 bn in cash, about 13x expected UIG 2027 EBITDA per Vertiv, with up to $1.15 bn more in cash tied to financial targets over 12 and 24 months. Vertiv expects UIG to be accretive to adjusted EPS in the first year.

Management expects 800V DC architecture to enter customer validation and begin generating revenue during 2027, with broader deployment in 2028. Vertiv is working with a combination of hyperscalers and silicon partners on it.
Vertiv continues to expect to be price-cost positive in 2026, including tariff impacts and countermeasures.

4Q26 guidance raised: revenue $4,313 mn-$4,513 mn (from $4,225 mn-$4,425 mn), adjusted operating profit $1,118 mn-$1,158 mn, adjusted EPS $2.22-$2.28 (from $2.17-$2.23). Midpoints vs Street: revenue $4,413 mn vs $4,307 mn, EPS $2.25 vs $2.21.

2026 guidance raised: revenue $14,450 mn-$14,850 mn (from $13,800 mn-$14,200 mn), up 37-39% yoy organically; EBIT $3,475 mn-$3,555 mn (from $3,285 mn-$3,365 mn); adjusted EPS $7.10-$7.20 (from $6.65-$6.75); FCF $2,600 mn-$2,800 mn (from $2,400 mn-$2,600 mn).
GS raises 2026/27/28 EPS estimates to $7.17/$9.85/$12.50 from $6.75/$9.25/$11.55 on higher revenue and margins. Revenue estimates rise to $14,722 mn/$19,257 mn/$23,174 mn.

GS maintains Buy and raises the 12-month price target to $313 from $301, based on 20x EV/EBITDA (down from 22x, reflecting lower peer multiples) applied to Q5-Q8 EBITDA. Price was $242.94, implying 28.8% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 beat and raised 2026 guidance, with orders up over 100% organically yoy and momentum into 2027. Target raised to $313 from $301 on 20x EV/EBITDA, down from 22x.

earnings_insights: VRT 3Q26 reported 10/28: revenue $4,313 mn vs Street (FactSet) $3,749 mn and GS $3,765 mn; non-GAAP operating income $1,087 mn vs Street $922 mn; non-GAAP adjusted EPS (including SBC) $2.21 reported vs Street est $1.82 and GS est $1.81.

VRT 4Q26 guidance: revenue $4,313 mn-$4,513 mn (midpoint $4,413 mn vs Street est $4,307 mn), adjusted operating profit $1,118 mn-$1,158 mn, adjusted EPS $2.22-$2.28 (midpoint $2.25 vs Street est $2.21). Margin guidance midpoint 25.8% vs GS est 26.2% and Street est 26.0%.

VRT 2026 guidance: revenue $14,450 mn-$14,850 mn vs Street est $14,008 mn, adjusted EPS $7.10-$7.20 vs Street est $6.73, non-GAAP operating income midpoint $3,515 mn (24.0% margin) vs Street est $3,330 mn.
GS 2026/27/28 adjusted EPS estimates $7.17/$9.85/$12.50 (prior $6.75/$9.25/$11.55). GS quarterly EPS estimates: 4Q26 $2.27, 1Q27 $1.79, 2Q27 $2.50.
risk_factors: Revenue: part of datacenter revenue is tied to traditional on-premise datacenters, which could be hurt by enterprise spending weakness or the shift to cloud. Growth also depends on Vertiv's ability to improve cloud/hyperscale revenue and grow in the channel, and on market share.
Margins: risk to expected margin expansion from competitive pressure, mix, execution or tariffs.
